scripts.prebuild: npm run build:slim && npm run build:pubmaxxing-seed
scripts.prestart:
node -e "const d=process.env.NEXT_DIST_DIR||'.next'; require('fs').existsSync(d+'/BUILD_ID') || (console.error('
✗ '+d+'/BUILD_ID is missing — there is no completed production build to serve.
  Run npm run build to completion first. In this shared worktree a concurrent next dev/next build can clobber .next mid-build and leave it partial; for isolated production QA use NEXT_DIST_DIR=.next-prod.
'), process.exit(1))"
scripts.shots: PUBMAX_E2E_KEYLESS=1 PW_SCREENSHOTS=1 PUBMAX_TRACKED_OUTPUTS=docs/screenshots node scripts/run-with-restored-next-env.mjs sh -c 'npm run build && base=$((30000 + ($$ % 10000))); i=0; for p in shots-390-light shots-1440-light shots-390-dark shots-1440-dark; do PW_PORT=$((base + i)) playwright test --workers=1 --project=$p || exit; i=$((i + 1)); done'
scripts.shots:extended: PUBMAX_E2E_KEYLESS=1 PW_SCREENSHOTS=1 PUBMAX_TRACKED_OUTPUTS=docs/screenshots node scripts/run-with-restored-next-env.mjs sh -c 'npm run build && base=$((30000 + ($$ % 10000))); i=0; for p in shots-390-light shots-430-light shots-1280-light shots-1440-light shots-390-dark shots-430-dark shots-1280-dark shots-1440-dark; do PW_PORT=$((base + i)) playwright test --workers=1 --project=$p || exit; i=$((i + 1)); done'
scripts.prevalidate-data: npm run build:slim && npm run build:pubmaxxing-seed
scripts.verify: npm run validate-data && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run coverage && npm audit --audit-level=high
scripts.ci: npm run verify && npm run build
scripts.setup: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && echo 'git hooks enabled (pre-push runs npm run verify)'
